Class AddCityController

java.lang.Object
pt.ipp.isep.dei.controller.AddCityController
public class AddCityController extends Object
Controller for the "Add City" use case.

Manages creating a new City, validating inputs, assigning house blocks, and persisting the city to the map repository.

    • startAddCity

    • submitCityDetails

      public City submitCityDetails(String name, int x, int y, int houseBlocks)
      Submits the basic city details and validates them.
      Parameters:
      name - the city name (non-null, non-empty)
      x - X coordinate of the city center
      y - Y coordinate of the city center
      houseBlocks - number of house blocks (> 0)
      Returns:
      the created City instance
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if validation fails
      IllegalStateException - if the city name already exists on the map

    • selectedAssignmentMethod

      public City selectedAssignmentMethod(String method, List<Location> positions)
      Assigns house blocks according to the chosen method.

      For manual assignment, validates that all positions are within map bounds.

      Parameters:
      method - either "automatic" or "manual"
      positions - list of block positions (required if manual)
      Returns:
      the City with assigned blocks
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if method is unknown or positions invalid
      IllegalStateException - if manual positions are out of bounds
